findings.title: P01 push-0x28 creation-site VAs cite the ctor CALL, not the PUSH; exact push VAs unstated (root's open finding RESOLVED)
findings.line_field: premise_correction.finding ('PUSH 0x28 (6a 28) before the ctor call at BOTH creation sites (callsites 0x521b94, 0x5b7272; verified from raw bytes)')
findings.evidence: Independent raw read: 0x521b94 = e8 77 35 09 00 (CALL -> 0x5b5110, X ctor) and 0x5b7272 = e8 99 de ff ff (CALL -> 0x5b5110); the actual '6a 28' bytes are at 0x521b78 and 0x5b7256, followed in both sites by 8b f9/e8...->operator_new(0x28)->mov [esp+8],eax->...->mov ecx,eax->call ctor. The X-size-0x28 premise is BYTE-SUPPORTED (6a 28 = push 0x28 present at both sites, immediately before operator_new+ctor).
findings.effect: root countercheck 'cannot confirm 6a 28 at cited VAs' is explained and resolved: cited VAs are the CALL sites, as the prose actually says; the premise stands.
findings.required_correction: record the exact push VAs (0x521b78, 0x5b7256) in the final report / erratum so future byte checks cite the instruction, not the disp/call site.
